articles.summary: Do you need climate-controlled storage in a humid climate? Yes, climate-controlled storage is worth considering in a humid climate, particularly if you’re storing furniture, electronics, photographs, documents, or other belongings that can be sensitive to moisture and changes in temperature and humidity. Humidity can affect certain materials over time, potentially contributing to mold, mildew, odors, warping, rust, and other forms of damage. Climate-controlled [...]
